## First Section

```{r}
library(dplyr)
seq(1, 10) |> 
  sum()
```

```{r}
#| warning: false
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(airquality, aes(Temp, Ozone)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess")
```

### Demo code values in text

```{r}
 num_students <- 197
 num_sections <- 8
 num_students_per_section <- num_students / num_sections
 
```

i can make a paragraph with values in it like this:

there are `r num_students` in class with `r num_sections` sections. so there are `r num_students_per_section` per section in this class.

## Lecture Exercise 04

Load fake student data

```{r}
fake_student_df <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kylethayer/Info-201-au-24-datasets/refs/heads/main/demo_L03_fake_students.csv")
```

Load dplyr library

```{r}
library("dplyr")
```

Display summary of data

```{r}
summary(fake_student_df)
```
